name: Urbicana
description: Connects this Gateway to its owner's Boostt account: holds the owner's Boostt user id, and keeps the owner's A2A card in the agent workspace so the agent runs as its owner.

railsUrl.label: Boostt API origin
railsUrl.help: Where Boostt answers `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and `GET /api/v1/a2a/card`. No path, no trailing slash.

cardFile.label: Card file in the workspace
cardFile.help: Where the owner's A2A card is written, relative to the agent workspace. Its basename must be one the bootstrap-extra-files hook loads; the default is urbicana/IDENTITY.md.
